summary: Autonomous initiative-level review across member items and criteria.
description: One agent round that reviews a whole initiative against its acceptance criteria once all member items are terminal (mirrors internal/initiativereview/trigger.go). Reuses the review round schema and classification vocabulary at the initiative scope. Requires member items + acceptance criteria + review artifacts, so it only runs against an initiative.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Normalized acceptance verdict. The review mode's raw classification (ready/ready_with_notes -> accepted, needs_work -> changes-requested, not_assessable -> needs-attention, invalid -> failed) maps onto this closed set.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: The review handoff: assessment, classification, evidence gathered, and improvement suggestions.

outcomes.name: accepted
outcomes.description: The reviewed work meets its criteria; the workflow completes.

outcomes.name: changes-requested
outcomes.description: Specific fixable gaps were found; the workflow requests a revision/fixup.

outcomes.name: failed
outcomes.description: The review round itself failed (unassessable or invalid).

outcomes.name: needs-attention
outcomes.description: The verdict could not be derived honestly; the round abstains to operator attention.
